name: SAPNavigate
description: Navigate code: definitions, references (where-used), completion, class hierarchy. references uses the scope-based Where-Used API (line numbers, snippets, package); optional objectType filters by ADT slash type (e.g. CLAS/OC, PROG/P); pass type+name instead of uri. hierarchy returns superclass + interfaces + direct subclasses. For CDS (DDLS), prefer SAPContext(action="impact") — the same where-used pre-classified into RAP buckets, answering "what breaks if I change this view". Experimental relations: live active CLAS/INTF metadata network; requires type+name, no uri/source. Native coverage is unknown; not a complete call graph. No database or source collection.

uri.description: Source URI of the object. Optional for references if type+name are provided.

type.description: Object type (PROG, CLAS, INTF, FUNC, etc.) — alternative to uri for references.

name.description: Object name — alternative to uri for references.

objectType.description: references: keep only results of this ADT type, slash format (CLAS/OC, PROG/P, FUGR/FF). A bare prefix ("CLAS") matches every subtype.

maxResults.description: references: max entries (default 100, max 1000). "total" counts every match of the filter. relations: node limit including root (default 50, integer 1–100); hard limits may stop earlier.

direction.description: relations only: objects using the root, or objects it uses (default outgoing).

depth.description: relations only: native expansion steps (default 1), not proven source-call hops.

expandPackages.description: relations only: exact packages to expand beyond root. Other packages remain visible boundary nodes; not an access-control filter.
